info.title: Kizuna Rail API
info.description: API for the Kizuna Rail website.

SessionCookieAuth.name: connect.sid
SessionCookieAuth.description: Express session cookie set after login.

post.description: Authenticates a guest. Requests with an active session are rejected; log out before switching accounts.

409.description: A user is already logged in in this session.

post.description: Logs out the currently authenticated user.

400.description: No user is currently logged in.

post.description: Guests and admins may create a customer account. Signed-in customers are not allowed to register another account.

403.description: Signed-in customer cannot register another account.

get.description: Admin only. Password hashes are never returned.

post.description: Guests and admins may create customer accounts. Signed-in customers are forbidden.

400.description: Required registration data is missing or invalid.

get.description: The user may retrieve their own record; admins may retrieve any user.

403.description: The caller is neither this user nor an admin.

put.description: Users may update their own name and email. Admins may update any user and may also set role.

403.description: Caller is not authorized or cannot change roles.

delete.description: Users may delete their own account; admins may delete any account. Associated bookings are deleted too.

403.description: Caller is neither this user nor an admin.

get.summary: Get a role by user ID
Get a paginated list of trains
get.description: Returns trains from the trains collection, paginated and sorted.
Returns one train matching the requested ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the train to retrieve, such as kiha-261

get.summary: Get the trips a train runs
get.description: Returns every trip whose trainId matches the requested train.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the train to look up trips for, such as kiha-261

get.description: Returns every schedule in the schedule collection
Returns one schedule matching the requested ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the schedule to retrieve, such as 1

400.description: Schedule ID must be an integer.

get.description: Returns schedules for a trip, with optional month filtering.
Returns every station in the stations collection
Returns one station matching the requested ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the station to retrieve, such as nagoya

get.summary: Get a paginated list of trips
get.description: Returns trips one page at a time, sorted by the chosen field. A page beyond the last one returns an empty data array with a 200. Invalid page, limit, or sort values return 400.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Only return trips in this region, such as central

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Only return trips whose best season matches, such as summer

400.description: Invalid page, limit, or sort value

get.description: Returns one trip matching the requested ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the trip to retrieve, such as alpine-panorama

put.description: Updates trip details. Station values must match station names in the catalog; schedule IDs are numeric IDs from GET /api/schedules.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The custom unique string identifier of the trip to update

description.example: Journey through the Japanese Alps with stunning mountain views and traditional villages.

scheduleIds.description: Numeric IDs of existing schedules to associate with this trip

example.name: Alpine Panorama Express
example.description: Journey through the Japanese Alps with stunning mountain views and traditional villages.

200.description: Trip and schedule associations updated successfully.

400.description: Bad Request. Selected stations or schedules do not exist in the database.

401.description: Unauthorized. User is not logged into the session.

403.description: Forbidden. Authenticated user does not have the admin role.

404.description: Trip was not found matching the custom ID.

delete.description: Deletes a trip record by its custom ID. Automatically triggers a cascading deletion to remove all associated schedules.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The custom unique string identifier of the trip to delete

200.description: Trip and all of its cascading schedule dependencies deleted successfully.

401.description: Unauthorized. User is not logged into the session.

403.description: Forbidden. Authenticated user does not have the admin role.

404.description: Trip was not found matching the custom ID.

get.description: Admins see all bookings. Other signed-in users see bookings they created or are listed as a passenger on.

post.description: Creates a booking for the signed-in user. The caller becomes the booking creator.

400.description: Booking details are invalid or the schedule, day, or ticket class is unavailable.

get.description: Calculates the additional fare for every seat in a booking. No payment is processed.

400.description: Invalid ticket class or the selected class is not an upgrade.

403.description: Only the booking creator or an admin may upgrade it.

get.description: Returns one booking to its owner or an admin.

put.description: The booking creator or an admin may edit passenger details or upgrade every seat to a higher ticket class. No payment is processed.

400.description: Invalid passenger details or a ticket class that is not an upgrade.

403.description: Not authorized to edit this booking

delete.description: The booking creator or an admin may delete the entire booking.

403.description: Not authorized to delete this booking

get.description: Users may retrieve bookings they created or are listed as a passenger on; admins may retrieve any user's bookings.

404.description: User not found or user has no bookings.

get.description: Returns all ticket classes or filters them by an available day.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: The day of the week to filter ticket availability.

400.description: Day query parameter is missing or invalid.

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of bookings

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number to retrieve (default is 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of bookings to retrieve per page (default is 10, maximum is 50)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by (default is 'createdAt'). Allowed values are 'createdAt', 'selectedDay', 'ticketClass', 'tripId', 'scheduleId'.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order of sorting (default is 'asc'). Use 'desc' for descending order.

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the booking

scheduleId.description: The schedule ID associated with the booking

tripId.description: The trip ID associated with the booking

ticketClass.description: The class of the ticket booked

selectedDay.description: The selected day for the booking

createdAt.description: The date and time when the booking was created

field.description: The field that caused the error
